architecture_finding: The architecture requires accepted quantized values but declares no numerical coordinate quantum, rounding mode, or grid.

decision.authoritative_value: The finite Python float produced by the existing GameSession server validation after numeric type conversion and arena-bounds validation.
decision.recorder_rule: Record exactly the coordinate value applied by GameSession; the recorder must not transform its copy independently.

sequence_and_coalescing.sequence_rule: Client sequence numbers are bounded nonnegative integers and must increase strictly.
sequence_and_coalescing.aim_rule: For valid aim updates pending at one authoritative control boundary, only the greatest accepted sequence is applied; earlier pending aims are coalesced diagnostics, not applied inputs.
sequence_and_coalescing.attack_rule: A pending aim is applied before a same-tick attack commit; the attack then locks its own validated coordinates immutably.

scope: M09 capture semantics only; no M08 GameSpec, neural, controller, encoder, decoder, graph, kernel, or movement parameter changes.
